fee_notes: Standard Initial Franchise Fee is $35,000 for traditional and non-traditional Pinkberry restaurants. Reduced to $17,500 for second and subsequent traditional/non-traditional restaurants (excluding vending machines). Vending machine locations are $15,000 per unit, reduced to $10,000 per vending machine if three are purchased simultaneously. Eligible Military (active, active reserve, or honorably discharged U.S. Armed Forces) and 501(c)(3) organizations receive a 20% discount (e.g., $28,000 for standard fee). No refunds under any circumstances. No Initial Franchise Fee due on transfer or renewal. Fee may be periodically reduced for limited-time promotions.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for all traditional and non-traditional Pinkberry restaurants is $35,000 ("Initial Franchise Fee") and is reduced for your second and each subsequent traditional or non-traditional restaurant to $17,500. Notwithstanding the above, the Initial Franchise Fee for a non-traditional Pinkberry location that is a vending machine is $15,000 per vending machine, and is reduced to $10,000 per vending machine if you purchase three (3) vending machines at the same time.
